category_edits.rationale: Across all four categories, increase hidden width from 64 to 96 and dropout from 0.15 to 0.20. Added capacity may capture more item relationships, while stronger dropout limits overfitting. Existing metadata and predictor reconstruction propagate the trained width automatically. Preserve all other hyperparameters, features, loss, causal backbone, routing and single-checkpoint inference.

change_summary: Jointly increase NextItNet width to 96 and dropout to 0.20 for all four independent category models; existing metadata preserves predictor shape consistency.
